dsh-vision#vision-tool 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。给 DeepSeek Harness 的纯文本模型补上免费识图：`vision` 工具直连智谱 GLM 视觉 API 描述/OCR 图片文件（glm-4v-flash 降级链），无需任何外部 CLI。

posts.en:
dsh-vision#vision-tool is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Model-facing `vision` tool for DeepSeek Harness: describe and OCR image files by calling the free Zhipu GLM vision API directly (glm-4v-flash fallback chain), no external CLI required.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-71f11abfe5dde2d20c2b.html
